brief: Deep forest under a great banyan tree: the poet Guṇāḍhya writes on palm leaves with a reed pen dipped in a small dark-red pot (no wound shown). Spirits of soft blue light and forest animals gather at a distance, listening. Calm, reverent, golden evening light.
